acceptanceCriteria: All P0 and P1 release blockers are closed and two unchanged-candidate qualification runs pass.
The selected signing or publisher-identity policy is exercised on the exact RC artifacts.
The candidate-bound stable-readiness record is complete before the owner approves publication; it does not treat publication or promotion as a prerequisite.
The RC is published only with owner approval and its documented rollback is executed successfully.
body:
Close release blockers and publish the signed or publisher-bound release candidate. Publication remains distinct from stable promotion.

2026-09-29 owner policy accepted for both 1.0.0-rc.2 and 1.0.0: no signing; verified SHA256SUMS and retained reproducibility evidence; publisher identity NOT_VERIFIED; latest non-withdrawn stable artifact set supported until its next stable successor, prereleases do not retire stable, withdrawals immediate, existing seven-day acknowledgement target and no fix-time SLA. Decision 0428 committed in isolated integration at 96a69bbd. This is policy selection only; exact candidate qualification, publication and stable promotion approvals remain outstanding.
title: Close blockers and publish the 1.0 release candidate
